subject.title: docs(onboarding): finalize phase status and phase 7 decision

question: Does the phase-7 documentation accurately capture the intended owner decision boundary and the recommendation for CLI-side auto-doctor without prematurely committing OpenClaw to a startup-policy design?
rationale: The patch deliberately records an unresolved product/security boundary rather than a purely historical fact, and the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling.

options.title: Confirm and merge
options.body: Confirm that the memo is the intended current planning record, leaving phase 7 unscheduled until its implementation receives separate owner and security review.

options.title: Revise the decision memo
options.body: Adjust or remove the recommendation if the owner wants the plan to remain neutral until a concrete phase-7 proposal is reviewed.

recommendation.title: Confirm and merge
recommendation.body: Confirm that the memo is the intended current planning record, leaving phase 7 unscheduled until its implementation receives separate owner and security review.
